question: What is the technological resource known as controlled flocculation ?:

options.opa: In the incorporation into the formulation of chelating substances such as EDTA that act as flocculants.
options.opb: In the addition of electrolytes to modify the Z potential and improve the stability of colloidal systems such as suspensions and emulsions.
options.opc: In the modification of the particle size by electric shocks to modify the degree of flocculation in colloidal systems.
options.opd: In the incorporation of viscosifying agents that modify the rheological properties of suspensions and gels.
